The unique three-step image generation method aims to address the phenomenon where models are overly constrained in their image generation capabilities due to factors such as LORA and artist tags. By employing multiple steps of generation, it provides the greatest operational space for the generation process.

This workflow is simple and easy to understand, including LoRa, amplification, facial restoration, and one-stop photo generation. The default number of steps and amplification coefficient take around 450 to 570 seconds on the RTX 3060. You can adjust the number of steps and amplification coefficient according to your needs.

The default model is for testing purposes only. You can use any model you prefer.

Some of the parameters were set based on the workflow of Legendaer.
